title: The Day of the Two Orange Shovels
skyStory: The moon has drifted into Aquarius, the sign of odd inventions and strange coincidences, and at one percent it is basically invisible and loving it. An invisible moon can get away with anything. Tonight it is rearranging the universe's furniture to make sure two friends notice the same peculiar thing on the same day. Aquarius cackles softly.

reading: You will see a bright orange snow shovel today, leaning somewhere it should not be. Maybe against a mailbox. Maybe on a porch with no snow. Take note. It is about to become very important, in a completely ridiculous way.

Otherwise the day is easygoing. People will ask you to explain something and you will do it so well that someone takes notes. Life Path 3 shines in this kind of light. Around 6 pm you will want to tell Nancy something odd. Do it. The universe has set this one up carefully.
joel.mission: Photograph the strangest object you see outside today and send it without any explanation.
joel.omen: An orange shovel in an odd spot. If you hear about another one before bedtime, don't even scream.

reading: The Wood Rat sees what others miss, and today that includes one very orange snow shovel abandoned in a place that makes zero sense. You will tilt your head at it. You might take a picture. You will not know why it feels important yet.

Then a message arrives, and there it is. Another orange shovel, in another town, at almost the same hour. DES. The universe has a sense of humour, and today it is wearing hi-vis. Spend the evening wondering what the shovels want. The answer is probably nothing, which is the funniest answer of all.
nancy.mission: Ask someone today what the most suspicious object in their neighbourhood is, and listen to the whole story.
nancy.omen: Something orange in the snow. It means a happy coincidence is circling and about to land.
nancy.stoneWhy: Joel's stone, ready for matching shovels

together.text: Two orange shovels, two towns, one afternoon. ΔΕΣ, obviously. Agree on what the shovels are trying to tell you and write it down as an official prophecy. Then check back in a month and see whether the shovels were right.
